description: This file contains functions for resolving approval request account IDs and channels, including session binding resolution, normalization, and matching logic, specific to approval request handling in the application.

methods.name: normalizeOptionalString
methods.description: Normalizes a string value by trimming and returning undefined if empty or null.

methods.name: normalizeOptionalChannel
methods.description: Normalizes a message channel string, returning undefined if input is null or undefined.

methods.name: resolvePersistedApprovalRequestSessionBinding
methods.description: Resolves session binding information (channel and accountId) from a persisted session store based on approval request session key.

methods.name: resolveApprovalRequestAccountId
methods.description: Determines the account ID associated with an approval request, considering session binding and request parameters.

methods.name: resolveApprovalRequestChannelAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the account ID associated with an approval request for a specific channel, considering session binding.

methods.name: doesApprovalRequestMatchChannelAccount
methods.description: Checks if an approval request matches a specific channel and account ID, considering session binding and request details.
